basis: Developmental pilosebaceous skin lesions define the condition; neurologic, ocular and skeletal abnormalities are each reported in only 5-29%.
Hemorrhagic inflammation of the brain; infectious ancestry and immune-mediated forms support the mechanism axis. Local bleeding does not establish a blood disorder.
Skeletal dysplasia, intellectual disability and hearing loss define it; cleft palate occurs in 18/18 and tooth agenesis in 80-99%, supporting gastrointestinal involvement.
Lysosomal metabolic dysfunction defines this heterogeneous umbrella; additional organ damage varies substantially by subtype and is not established across most patients.
Deposits are located in the cornea; no systemic cause or additional organ damage is specified.
Malignant neoplasm of the adrenal endocrine gland; metastatic sites are not intrinsic organ labels.
Ovarian epithelial malignancy arises in a reproductive organ; endocrine dysfunction is not defining, and no qualifying extraorgan damage is established.
Primary lymphatic vessel and valve dysfunction causes persistent limb lymphedema; mapped to the vascular axis. Swelling alone does not establish separate skin damage.
A mesenchymal soft-tissue sarcoma, typically arising in the connective tissues of the limbs; spindle-cell morphology adds no organ axis.
Hereditary corticospinal tract disease causes spastic paraplegia; urinary urgency in 11/30 is a neurologic symptom without evidence of urinary tract damage.
Developmental CNS abnormalities and syndactyly define it; macular degeneration and choroidal neovascularization are frequent (30-79%), supporting ocular involvement.
An inherited LDL biochemical variation maps to lipid metabolism; the record establishes no direct cardiovascular or other organ damage.
Ectopic endometrial tissue occupies a cutaneous scar; the specified disease site is skin.
Nonsyndromic inherited hearing loss; no extraotologic disease is specified.
Squamous carcinoma arising in the stomach; histologic resemblance to other sites does not imply their involvement.
Inherited retinal degeneration caused by biallelic LCA5 variants; retinal disease belongs to the ocular axis.
Immune dysregulation with lymphopenia/cytopenias; enteropathy affects ~50-60%, dermatitis 30-79%. Bronchiectasis is 5-29%; recurrent infections alone do not establish intrinsic lung damage.
Formaldehyde poisoning causes corrosive airway injury after inhalation or gastrointestinal injury after ingestion; additional systemic damage depends on route and severity.
Storage disease with defining dysostosis and corneal opacity; valve damage in 27/28. Cap excludes skin thickening (26/28), airway disease (23/28) and frequent hearing loss.
Muscle weakness with abnormal muscle mitochondria supports myopathy; ophthalmoplegia and ptosis (20/20) define ocular dysfunction. Additional nerve involvement is unquantified.
Bony osteophytes of the distal interphalangeal joints.
Neoplasm occupying the femur, a skeletal bone; no additional organ involvement is established.
Complex I metabolic defect; developmental impairment, cardiomyopathy/heart failure and pigmentary retinopathy each reported in 1/1. Cap excludes unquantified myopathy.
MELAS is defined by mitochondrial encephalomyopathy and lactic acidosis; sensorineural hearing loss affects roughly half of MELAS patients, though MT-ND1-specific frequency is uncertain.
Ependymal CNS tumour arising in the posterior fossa; molecular subgroup features do not add organ axes.
